title: Bar Crawl or Party Barge?
why: Comparison for bachelorette and birthday planners against the nemesis default (the downtown bar crawl), no competitors named.
hook_options: Bar crawl or party barge? Run the numbers.
The maid of honor needs to see this.
caption: Same group, same Saturday. One plan has four Ubers, a cover charge, and a lost bride. The other has a cooler and a sunset. Send this to the maid of honor. #HoustonBachelorette #HoustonPartyBarge #ClearLake #Kemah

slides.headline: Bar crawl or party barge? Run the numbers.
slides.body: Same group, same Saturday. One plan has five Ubers and a cover charge. The other has a cooler.

slides.headline: Five bars. Four Ubers. One lost bride.
slides.body: Somebody is always outside looking for the group. Usually the one in the veil.

slides.headline: One boat. Everyone in one place.
slides.body: Up to 26 of you on one deck. Nobody wanders off to a different bar.

slides.headline: A tab that keeps climbing.
slides.body: A 20-person night out in Houston runs $600 to $800 in drinks alone. Then the Ubers.

slides.headline: BYOB. You already paid for the drinks.
slides.body: Bring the cooler you stocked at the grocery store. No markup, no minimum, no surprise at close.

slides.headline: Fighting for the aux at every stop.
slides.body: Every bar has its own DJ and its own idea of a good song.

slides.headline: Your speaker. Your songs. All cruise.
slides.body: Connect at the dock and the bride runs the playlist for 1 hour 45 minutes.

slides.headline: The view is a parking lot.
slides.body: Downtown at 11pm looks like every other Saturday.

slides.headline: Kemah lights and a sunset for the photos.
slides.body: Clear Lake at golden hour. The group photo finally has a background worth posting.

slides.headline: Skip the crawl. Book the boat.
slides.body: Private charters for up to 26 out of Seabrook. Send this to the maid of honor. houstonpedalbarge.com
